title: Lately, gardening has become more than a beloved hobby. It’s become my lifeline. This is my tiny coup. Every morning, instead of doomscrolling the news, I leave my phone on the kitchen table, go outside, and, even for just a half-hour, stick my hands in dirt. - Beth Macy for Congress
